summary.text: This resolution supports the goals and ideals of American Grown Flower and Foliage Month and recognizes that purchasing flowers and foliage grown in the United States supports the farmers, small businesses, jobs, and economy of the United States.

title: Expressing support for the designation of July 2026 as "American Grown Flower and Foliage Month".
